biggest_catch: The company no longer exists — any site claiming to be Cardpool today is not the original exchange.
catches: Cardpool permanently closed in February 2021; the domain no longer operates a gift card exchange.
The closure followed a 2019 data breach (895,000 gift card codes, 330,000 payment cards) that was not disclosed while operating.
Buyer guarantees died with the company; sellers were paid out at closure but no new transactions are possible.

c1.evidence: frequentmiler.com: 'Gift card resale site Cardpool has permanently shut down.' gcgalore.com: 'Cardpool has announced that they are closing permanently' (update 2/8/21)

c2.evidence: No live official terms exist; the exchange shut down in Feb 2021

maximize: Do not attempt to use Cardpool or lookalikes. Use CardCash, CardsSell, Raise, or GiftCash instead — all verified as live alternatives in this lane.
notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Cardpool (founded 2009, acquired by Blackhawk Network 2011) shut down permanently Feb 2021 citing pandemic revenue collapse; breach of 2019 (895k gift card codes, 330k payment cards per Gemini Advisory via gcgalore.com/cyberint) surfaced around closure. Included as a reject so the catalog never recommends a dead platform.
